about.body: We're a Bowling Green landscaping team that shows up when we say we will. Carlos leads every job personally.

reviews.name: Christa A.
reviews.text: Shepherds has completed several projects at our home from tree service to our new patio and fire-pit. They are excellent, always professional, and do GREAT work!

reviews.name: TJ H.
reviews.text: Carlos and his crew trim trees the right way — safe for the tree and looks good. They ask how I like it before they leave and always clean up after themselves.

reviews.name: Haley W.
reviews.text: Amazing work on our overgrown flower bed. Removed weeds, trimmed everything back, and replaced old mulch with rock. The team showed up ready to work.
